No, I guess it doesn't. It's just extra info. So if I do 18 minus 3, that's my answer. Are you sure that's the right way to do it?

You've correctly identified that the first chapter is irrelevant to this specific question. Subtracting the smaller value (the third chapter) from the larger value (the second chapter) is exactly the right method for finding how many more pages there are.
